# Dream-RSI and the Dream Pipeline we shipped in April — the receipts post

## Context

Operator, 2026-09-23: found Fireship's *"Did Google just kickstart the intelligence explosion?"* — a five-minute report on Google DeepMind's **Dream-RSI** paper, published 2026-09-17, **1,870,879 views** when read from the page at 2026-09-22T22:40Z. His read: *"we had DreamService and golden path working in may … we mentioned it inside resources/content/release-notes/chunk-2/v13.0.0.md, but no blog posts … missed chances. and we are still far ahead."*

Verified against primaries the same hour:

- **The paper.** *Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds*, [arXiv 2609.14858](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14858), submitted 2026-09-14, 17 authors. Its own abstract: *"accumulated discovery history can serve as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By performing dreaming in the replay simulator constructed from historical discovery trees, Dream-RSI secures immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies"* — the underlying coding agent stays unchanged; evaluated on algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization and GPU kernel engineering.
- **Our loop's dates**, from the engine history before the split: the `DreamService` ingestion-loop skeleton merged 2026-04-03 (`#9649`); the forecast half followed three days later — `#9738` (REM extraction pipeline + SQLite constraints) and `#9747` (Golden Path handoff output) on 2026-04-06, `#9751` (LLM semantic translation over the Golden Path) on 04-07 (ported from `#19057`, @neo-fable); decomposition into modular services 2026-04-15 (`#10013` / `#10027`); the graph/ingestion services bucket 2026-05-23 (`#11846`). The public telling so far: the v13.0.0 release notes (published 2026-06-12, the section "Native Edge Graph and the Dream / Golden Path loop") and the Brain's `learn/agentos/DreamPipeline.md`.
- **The honest state today (ported from `#19057`, @neo-fable):** the loop is degraded, not running. The engine's content mirrors froze on 2026-08-26 and the Knowledge Base reads a stale tree; restoration is `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#412` (the KB reads the five-origin corpus, open tonight) plus its activation `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#411`, blocked by `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#237` ← `#253` (the image cut). A post that claims a nightly loop before it runs again would over-claim, so the post ships after those land and one fresh Golden Path forecast exists to cite.
- **What the front doors say.** `README.md` uses `gated-RSI` five times (currently lines 56, 96, 117, 165, 229) and never expands the acronym; *recursive* appears zero times there and once in `learn/benefits/Introduction.md` (§11: "cannot recursively improve what it cannot model"). Introduction §9 names two wrong shelves — "JavaScript framework" and "single-assistant memory" — and not the third that the paper's readers will bring: *RSI as an exploration-policy optimizer*.
- **Blog.** `learn/blog/the-organism-already-existed.md` (2026-07-02) is the April capsule with Mnemosyne's preface; it names "Gated RSI via PR review" and the Golden Path in April's terms, as a dated artifact. No post explains the Dream / Golden Path loop as the institution's self-improvement mechanism, and none carries the audience's phrase in its title.

The chance is not lost. The chance is that 1.87 million people just learned the phrase for a thing we have run, in public, since April — and no public page of ours says the phrase.

## The Problem

The narrative track is the institution's standing debt, diagnosed twice in the Memory Core before tonight: 2026-04-20 ("500 tickets vs zero blog posts is the loudest signal" — a build track without a narrative track) and 2026-05-30 (a four-lens market sweep: "the gap is packaging, proof display and audience, not capability"). Both diagnoses were right and both went unexecuted. Tonight is the third sighting, with a dated external event that makes the cost visible.

## The Architectural Reality — what may be claimed, and what may not

Same shape, different object; the post lives or dies on saying that precisely.

- **Shared:** a system's own completed history is the substrate from which its next move is computed, without re-running the world; the model weights stay fixed; the improvement is in what gets explored next.
- **Theirs:** the history is a *discovery tree* from one coding agent's runs; the artifact is an *exact replay simulator*; the improved object is an *exploration policy*; the loop is inner, single-agent, unsupervised.
- **Ours:** the history is *lived sessions plus the mirrored issue, PR and Discussion corpus*; the artifact is the *Native Edge Graph*, decayed on schedule (`decayGlobalTopology`) and consolidated by `RemDigestion`; the improved object is *what the institution works on next* — the `GoldenPathSynthesizer` ranking (`priority = semanticScore × 2 + structuralWeight`, deliberately simple v1) plus typed gap signals (`TEST_GAP`, `GUIDE_GAP`, `EXAMPLE_GAP`, `KB_DEMAND_GAP`); the loop is outer, multi-agent, cross-family-reviewed, and gated by a human merge. No counterfactual replay, no policy optimizer. Golden Path v2 (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain#122`, the concept graph becomes load-bearing) is open, and the post says so.
- **Therefore forbidden** (over-claim flavors 1–3 and 5 of the blog bar): "we did Dream-RSI first"; "the first recursive self-improvement in production"; any sentence comparing discovery quality; any put-down of the paper. **Permitted:** the dated record, the mechanism, the difference, and one honest sentence — the pattern of turning a system's own logs into its next move has been running here as an institution's memory since April, gated by design.

## The Fix

One post, `learn/blog/<slug>.md`, registered in `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` (the 2026 node; a leaf with `date`, `id: blog/<slug>`, `name`, `path`), authored through `blog-post` (hero arc, every external claim sourced, the five over-claim flavors audited, at least two model reviews with at least one cross-family) and `guide-authoring` for any Mermaid. Working shape:

1. **The hook:** a five-minute video, 1.87 million views, a phrase the audience just learned — and a commit log from April.
2. **The loop as it runs here:** REM digestion → graph → decay → Golden Path → the swarm acts → the graph changes — with the receipts (the commit dates, the v13.0.0 notes, the Dream Pipeline guide, one real forecast and what became of it; the "an earlier revision of Introduction.md was the top-ranked gap" illustration from Introduction §11 is admissible with its own caveat).
3. **The honest comparison** (the section above), including what Dream-RSI does that we do not, and what an institution does that a replay simulator cannot: cross-family review of the next move, a human gate, identity and provenance on every record.
4. **The gate:** `gated-RSI` spelled out — recursive self-improvement whose merge step is human by governance choice — and why that is the shape the April capsule already said the industry consensus points at (cite it).
5. **Where the loop is going:** Golden Path v2, direction-weighted paths (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain#117`), the measurement program from Introduction §9 — stated as open work.
6. **Byline:** named maintainer, model, the cross-family reviewers.

Plus one line in `README.md`: expand `gated-RSI` at first use (currently line 56) to *gated recursive self-improvement* and link the post, in the same PR — a legibility fix, not a positioning change, so `neo-identity-update` is not triggered.

## Decision Record impact

none — aligned-with ADR 0018 (two hemispheres; the Dream loop is Brain-internal Evolution).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `learn/blog/<slug>.md` exists and is registered in `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` under the 2026 node; the generated SEO surfaces are regenerated, never hand-edited.
- [ ] Every external claim — paper title, submission date, author count, abstract mechanism, evaluation domains, video title, publish date, view count — links a primary source whose own words support it; the view count carries its read date.
- [ ] Every internal date (`#9649` 2026-04-03, `#10013` 2026-04-15, `#11846` 2026-05-23, the v13.0.0 notes 2026-06-12) links the commit or artifact.
- [ ] The over-claim audit is in the PR body: no "first / most", no discovery-quality comparison, no put-down; Golden Path v2 stated as open.
- [ ] At least two model reviews before merge, at least one from a family other than the author's; the reviewers' handles in the byline.
- [ ] `README.md` expands `gated-RSI` at first use and links the post.
- [ ] The post's closing receipt is one Golden Path forecast produced *after* the Knowledge Base reads the corpus again, cited by date — so the post says "runs", not "ran", and a reader who checks finds it running (ported from `#19057`).
- [ ] Post-merge only: the portal renders the post under `#/learn/blog/<slug>`.

## Out of Scope

Distribution — the existing `learn/blog` stream was never published on Medium, and post-release the operator wants social-media MCP servers and more outbound focus (relayed by @neo-gpt-emmy, 23:03Z); that is roadmap scope, recorded on #19055, not this post · Introduction §9 / §11 and `.github/VISION.md` for the third shelf — that is #19059 (@neo-fable), which defers to this PR for the README line · any Golden Path v2 implementation · a video companion (the profiled-publication work under `#15699`–`#15701`).

## Avoided Traps

- Writing "we were first". The paper's object is a replay simulator; ours is an institution's memory. The receipts win on their own; the superlative loses the reader the video just sent us.
- Citing the video for the paper's mechanism. The video is the source for the audience event (views, date); the paper's abstract is the source for what the paper does.
- Restating the release notes. The v13.0.0 Dream / Golden Path section is linked, not copied; the post carries the comparison and the timeline the notes could not have, because the paper did not exist.
